finding_catalog_entries.finding: NON CONFORMANCE TO THE APPROVED METHODOLOGY AND PROCEDURE FOR WELL DRILLING
finding_catalog_entries.recommendation: 1. DRILLING METHODS TO BE FOLLOWED - PERCUSSION DRILLING OR ROTARY DRILLING COMPLETE WITH EQUPMENT AND DRILLING ACCESSORIES 2. DRILLING CONTRACTORS SHOULD BE DULY REGISTERED AND WITH QUALIFIED DRILLERS 3. SOIL SAMPLES ARE COLLECTED EVERY 3 METERS OR EVERY CHANGE OF ROCK FORMATION, SAMPLES ARE PLACED IN A PLASTIC BAG LABELLED WITH DEPTH (M) AND DATE 4. DRILLER'S LOG IS KEPT INDICATING THE DAILY ACIVITIES, DRILLING RATE, WATER (OR MUD) LOSS AT WHAT LEVEL, DIFFICULTY OF DRILLING AT DEPTH, AND KIND OF SOIL ENCOUNTERED DURING DRILLING 5. USE OF DRILLLING MUD (COMMERCIALLY AVAILABLE BENTONITE OR EQUIVALENT) DURING DRILLING

finding_catalog_entries.finding: THE SEQUENCE OF INSTALLATION OF CASING IS NOT IN ACCORDANCE WITH APPROVED WELL DESIGN
finding_catalog_entries.recommendation: 1. WELL DESIGN SHOULD BE BASED ON THE DRILLING/ SOIL SAMPLES AND THE DRILLER'S LOG 2. THE LOCATION AND LENGTH OF SCREEN AND BLACK CASING ARE INDICATED IN THE DESIGN WHICH SHOULD BE APPROVED OR CONFIRMED BY THE LGU ENGINEER 3. THE CENTRALIZER AND SUMP/BLANK CASING (AT THE BOTTOM) SHOULD BE INDICATED IN THE DESIGN AND INSTALLED 4. THE WELL SCREEN SHOULD HAVE A MAXIMUM SLOT OPENING AND A WIRE-WOUND SCREEN IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED. TORCHED OR ACETYLENE-CUT SCREENS ARE NOT ALLOWED AS THIS WILL CREATE MORE PROBLEMS LATER 5. GRAVEL PACK MATERIALS (3-5MM ROUND PEBBLES) SHOULD BE INSTALLED AT THE ANNULAR SPACE BETWEEN THE BOREHOLE AND CASING/SCREEN. A GRAVEL PACK TUBE WITH END PLUG SHOULD BE INSTALLED TO REFILL GAVEL PACK MATERIALS 6. AFTER WELL CLEANING AND DEVELOPEMENT, A SANITARY SEAL OR GROUT (USING A CONCRETE MIXTURE 1:3:4) SHOULD BE INSTALLED AT LEAST 3 METERS FROM THE GROUND SURFACE 7. TEMPORARY WELL CASING PLUG OR COVER SHOULD BE INSTALLED SECURELY UNTIL THE INSTALLATION OF THE RIGHT PUMPING MACHINERY
finding_catalog_entries.reference: REF: TYPICAL WELL DESIGN

finding_catalog_entries.recommendation: DISINFECT ALL DRILLING RODS AND BITS BEFORE DRILLING AT SITE TO AVOID CONTAMINATION

finding_catalog_entries.finding: RIGHT PUMPING FACILITIES ARE NOT INSTALLED
finding_catalog_entries.recommendation: 1. THE PUMP (SUBMERSIBLE OR CENTRIFUGAL) SHOULD BE SIZED OR COMPUTED BASED ON THE RESULT OF THE PUMPING TEST (CONTINUOUS RATE PUMPING TEST AT LEAST 24 HOURS) PARTICULARLY THE PUMPING WATER LEVEL (M) VS STATIC WATER LEVEL (M) AND THE FLOW RATE (LPS) 2. THE PUMP SETTING SHOULD BE OPPOSITE THE BLANK CASING TO AVOID SAND AND SILT, AND AT LEAST 5 METERS FROM THE LOWEST PUMPING WATER LEVEL 3. IF THE PUMP WILL BE SET OPPOSITE THE SCREEN, A PROTECTIVE CASING (OR SHROUD) IS INSTALLED TO DIVERT SAND OR SILT (REFER TO THE DRAWING___) 4. THE PUMP SHOULD BE INSTALLED WITH PUMP CONTROL EQUIPPED WITH COMPLETE PUMP PROTECTION - OVERLOAD, TEMPERATURE SURGED, VOLTAGE PROTECTION, LOW WATER LEVEL PROTECTION, LIGHTNING PROTECTION, AND SHOULD HAVE A PANEL THAT IS ALL-WEATHER PROTECTED, LIGHTED AND SECURED. 5. AN EMERGENCY GENERATOR SET IS PROVIDED TO ENSURE CONTINUOUS POWER SUPPLY 6. A SPARE PUMP WITH THE SAME CAPACITY IS ALSO PROVIDED, IF BUDGET ALLOWS

finding_catalog_entries.finding: PUMPING TESTS NOT PROPERLY CONDUCTED
finding_catalog_entries.recommendation: 1. TWO TYPES OF PUMPING TEST ARE NORMALLY CONDUCTED: A) STEP-DRAWDOWN AND B) CONSTANT RATE PUMPING TEST 2. STEP-DRAWDOWN TEST IS CONDUCTED AT 3 DIFFERENT RATES: 1) 75% OF THE DESIGNED FLOW RATE, 2) 100% AND 3) 120%. EACH STEP SHOULD HAVE ABOUT 3 HOURS AND THE STATIC WATER LEVEL (ORIGINAL LEVEL), DRAWDOWN (PUMPING WATER LEVEL) AND FLOW RATE ARE MEASURED. AT THE END OF THE TEST, A RECOVERY TEST IS CONDUCTED. 3. CONSTANT RATE PUMPING TEST IS CONDUCTED USING THE 120% OF THE DESIGNED FLOW RATE, IF POSSIBLE, FOR 24 HOURS. THIS TEST IS CONDUCTED AFTER THE ORIGINAL WATER LEVEL IS REACHED. THE MEASUREMENT IS RECORDED FOLLOWING THE PRESCRIBED TIME INTERVAL (REFER TO ___). DURING THE PUPMING TEST, THE PUMPING WATER LEVEL AND FLOW RATE ARE MEASURED. ALSO WATER SAMPLES ARE COLLECTED TO CHECK THE WATER QUALITY. BUT FINAL WATER SAMPLE IS COLLECTED 2-3 MINUTES BEFORE THE END OF THIS TEST FOR LABORATORY TESTING. 4. DURING THE CONDUCT OF PUMPING TEST, MAKE SURE THE WATER DISCHARGE IS FAR FROM THE WELL SOURCE TO PREVENT DIRECT RECHARGE TO THE WELL WHICH MIGHT INFLUENCE THE PUMPING TEST RESULT
